facts.text: The class wraps a pyvisa instrument object passed to its constructor
get_screen_image writes a PNG screenshot to a file and returns its byte count
A screen image accepts the backcolor 'WHITE' or 'BLACK'
trigger_setup takes the trigger channel, level, horizontal offset, slope and mode
The trigger channel is a scope channel such as 'C1' or 'D1'
trigger_setup writes the VBS trigger commands and sets Trigger.Type to Edge
get_trigger_setup returns the channel, level, horizontal offset, slope, mode and trigger type under keys 0 to 5
get_analog_channel_setup returns the label, vertical scale, vertical offset, bandwidth limit and coupling of channels 1 to 8
get_digital_channel_setup returns the label of each enabled digital channel 0 to 15
get_measurement_setup reads measurement slots P1 to P12 and returns each source and parameter
getValueOnChannel reads value, mean, max, min, num and sdev as a float and status as text
setGrid accepts Single, Dual, Quad, Octal, Tandem, Quattro or Auto
setHorizontal_delay writes the horizontal offset in Horizontal.HorOffset
The README describes the class as configuration, measurement and screen capture for a LeCroy oscilloscope
